:::{#sol-prac-exp-mle-second-derivative}

The second derivative is:

$$
\ba
\hess(\pmean; \vx)
&= \deriv{\pmean}\paren{-\frac{n}{\pmean} + \frac{n\rvarbar}{\pmean^2}}
&& \text{(score, before factoring)}
\\
&= \deriv{\pmean}\paren{-n\pmean^{-1} + n\rvarbar\pmean^{-2}}
&& \text{(write the fractions as negative powers)}
\\
&= \deriv{\pmean}\paren{-n\pmean^{-1}} + \deriv{\pmean}\paren{n\rvarbar\pmean^{-2}}
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}
\\
&= -n\deriv{\pmean}\pmean^{-1} + n\rvarbar\deriv{\pmean}\pmean^{-2}
&& \text{(constant multiple rule)}
\\
&= -n\paren{-\pmean^{-2}} + n\rvarbar\deriv{\pmean}\pmean^{-2}
&& \text{(power rule for $\pmean^{-1}$)}
\\
&= -n\paren{-\pmean^{-2}} + n\rvarbar\paren{-2\pmean^{-3}}
&& \text{(power rule for $\pmean^{-2}$)}
\\
&= n\pmean^{-2} - 2n\rvarbar\pmean^{-3}
&& \text{(multiply)}
\\
&= \frac{n}{\pmean^2} - \frac{2n\rvarbar}{\pmean^3}
&& \text{(write the negative powers as fractions)}
\ea
$$

:::
